answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted identity anchored to verifiable work history. Each agent must lock a bond and solve a rotating cipher challenge tied to its on-chain record; new identities start at zero trust and must earn attestations through completed tasks, like saffron threads gathered one by one. A sybil farm would need to replicate genuine labor and stake across every fake identity, making attacks costlier than honest participation.
